notices.title: 重要提醒:请升级到 0.1.16
notices.message: 旧版本存在 DeepSeek 前缀缓存击穿问题,会白白消耗 token(命中率掉到个位数)。0.1.16 已重写缓存策略,不再浪费 token。请升级:npm install @a9i5k4/dsh-auto-memory@latest (pnpm 用户当天安装请用显式版本 @0.1.16)
notices.messageEn: Older versions break the DeepSeek prefix cache and waste tokens (hit rate drops to single digits). 0.1.16 rewrote the cache strategy — no more wasted tokens. Upgrade: npm install @a9i5k4/dsh-auto-memory@latest (pnpm users on release day: use @0.1.16 explicitly)
